author: /root/salvage_integration_review
scope: Seven-file EcoCyc native complex/RNA authority support on the actual merged next223 working baseline after reviewed complex, endpoint and BiGG adoption. No record science, authority snapshot or maintained adoption is performed here.

native_contract.namespace: EcoCyc; distinct from MetaCyc and ECOLI issuing PGDB code
native_contract.issuing_request: Exact HTTPS bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr/getxml?id=ECOLI:FRAME; strict case/local-frame syntax; no extra query, encoded substitutions, fragments, credentials, alternate ports or HTTP transport.
native_contract.serializer_exception: Exact observed same-host HTTP:443 XML base with naked ECOLI frame query and root service URL, plus exact HTTPS counterparts. No generic scheme/port normalization.
native_contract.identity: One metadata and one requested direct full Protein/RNA entity; exact PGDB ECOLI/version and matching Pathway Tools version, service/query/count, species Escherichia coli, strain K-12 substr. MG1655, native NCBI taxonomy unification 511145. Metadata shapes are intentionally bounded to observed native bodies.
native_contract.parent_types: Protein-Complexes or Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes for Protein; Regulatory-RNAs for RNA, exact native reference attributes.
native_contract.names: Exactly one direct safe string common-name; aliases only validated direct native synonyms. No nested frame promotion, activity fallback, cross-database mappings or contextual waiver. canonical_or_synonym policy applies only to these source labels.
native_contract.conflicts: Type, parent, label, alias set and version disagreement rejected before corpus selection; conflicting ECOLI releases and nonnative source kinds emitting EcoCyc rejected.
native_contract.xml: Native declared encoding retained; parser-level DOCTYPE rejection also covers UTF-16 and internal/external entity declarations. Safe existing name parser reused without modifying MetaCyc behavior.

biological_boundaries: CPLX0-226 names the CRP-cAMP complex; PC00004 names the CRP complex and does not itself assert cAMP occupancy. The adapter does not infer stoichiometric occupancy from uncoefficiented CPLX0-226 components.
RNA0-241 is SgrS RNA, not its gene G0-9941 or SgrT protein. CAMP and PD00257 remain reference-only identities in the corrected record, not new authority terms from this package.
No regulatory truth, component coefficients, sequence equivalence or chemical crosswalk is inferred by identifier support.
ui_and_export: Exact native/closed-schema prefix parity; public resolver https://ecocyc.org/gene?id=LOCAL_ID with safe local syntax. Existing explicit reference URLs retain precedence. Existing graph and KGX already preserve explicit RNA/complex types; no prefix classification added.

failure_lineage.result: 541 passed, 7 failed; 7 new fixture omissions, not production defects; original code, full logs, bindings and disposition preserved. Corrected fixtures passed in checks-final.

Native/closed schema and graph/KGX checks passed, then an incorrect external assertion required fallback citation URLs to override valid explicit record URLs. Diagnostic and successor v2 verify existing precedence without product edits.
